findings.evidence: sigmaMethod_x_eq_Q2_div (AccessMethods.lean:256) gives x_Σ = Q²_Σ/(2(p·k)y_Σ); trueInvariants_x_of_collinear_initialState + trueInvariants_y_of_collinear_initialState (Radiative.lean:417,397) give x = zQ²_e/(2(z p·k − p·k')) = Q²_e/(2(p·k)y). Hence x_Σ = x·Q²_Σ/Q²_e, and Q²_Σ = Q²_true = zQ²_e yields x_Σ = z x.
findings.fix: Add a clause: with any other virtuality `Q²_Σ` and the same `x_Σ = Q²_Σ/(2 (p·k) y_Σ)`, `x_Σ = x · Q²_Σ/Q²_e`, so BB's virtuality makes Q² exact at the cost of `x_Σ = z x`; exactness in both components additionally requires replacing the nominal `2 p·k` by the measured `2 p·(z k)`.
findings.issue: The `sigmaMethod` docstring says the Q² failure under collinear ISR is "an artifact of the choice `Q²_Σ := Q²_e`, not of the method of Bassler and Bernardi". With `x_Σ = Q²_Σ/(2 (p·k) y_Σ)` (`sigmaMethod_x_eq_Q2_div`, line 256) and `x = Q²/(2 p·(z k) y)`, exactness of x forces `Q²_Σ = z Q² = Q²_e`; adopting BB's `p²_{T,e}/(1−y_Σ)` (= the true Q²) would instead give `x_Σ = z x`. The shift is not removable, only movable, so the docstring misstates what a corrected `Q²_Σ` would buy.

findings.evidence: Radiative.lean:509-515 proves x_Σ = x using sigmaMethod_Q2 = Q²_e; combined with sigmaMethod_x_eq_Q2_div, replacing Q²_e by zQ²_e scales x_Σ by z.
findings.fix: Mirror the corrected wording: say that with `x_Σ = Q²_Σ/(2 (p·k) y_Σ)` exactly one of x and Q² can be exact, and that this lemma's x exactness depends on `Q²_Σ := Q²_e`.
findings.issue: Same claim repeated on `sigmaMethod_x_eq_trueInvariants_x_of_collinear_initialState`: "this is an artifact of that choice, not of the transverse-momentum virtuality of Bassler and Bernardi". Stated on the lemma that proves x exactness, it implies BB's virtuality would preserve that exactness while fixing Q²; it would not (x_Σ would become z x).

summary: All new definitions and statements reproduce under independent recomputation (ISR Q²=zQ²_e, 1−y_e=z(1−y), x_e=xy/y_e, x_Σ=x; FSR Q²_e=zQ²−(1−z)k²+z(1−z)k_out²; the bilinear expansions; the rest-frame reduction, which has a concrete Minkowski witness). The one defect is a misleading physics claim repeated in two docstrings: with the Σ-method x formula fixed as x_Σ=Q²_Σ/(2(p·k)y_Σ), substituting Bassler–Bernardi's virtuality does not remove the collinear-ISR shift, it moves it from Q² to x.
